newsitem.title: ITALY: Ambroveneto cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ambroveneto cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.

text.p: MILAN, Dec 13 - Italy's Banco Ambrosiano Veneto said it was cutting its prime rate by 50 basis points to 9.5 percent and its top rate 125 bps to 16.5 percent.
It said the new rates would take effect from December 23.
Ambroveneto is the third bank to cut its rates over the last 24 hours.
Banca Commerciale Italiana said earlier on Friday it was cutting its prime rate 50 bps to 9.5 percent and its top rate one percentage point to 16 percent, effective December 23.
Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said late on Thursday it was cutting its rates to 9.5 percent and 16 percent respectively from December 16.
The prime rate is the rate at which banks lend to their best customers and the top rate is the ceiling rate at which they lend to clients.
